headword: {肉体労働者|にくたいろうどうしゃ}
reading: にくたいろうどうしゃ

definitions.explanation: A person who earns a living through physical labor, such as construction or factory work, rather than office work.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{肉体労働者|にくたいろうどうしゃ}だ。
{肉体労働者|にくたいろうどうしゃ}は{体力|たいりょく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{若|わか}いころは{肉体労働者|にくたいろうどうしゃ}として{建設|けんせつ}{現場|げんば}で{働|はたら}いていた。
examples.english: When he was young, he worked as a manual laborer at construction sites.

notes:
Written {肉体|にくたい} (the body) + {労働者|ろうどうしゃ} (worker). Contrasts with office or desk work.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頭脳労働者|ずのうろうどうしゃ}: brain worker; white-collar worker — the contrasting term
- {作業員|さぎょういん}: worker, operative — a neutral term for someone doing on-site work
